# Restaurant Ordering App - Specification

## Project Overview

A small pizza restaurant wants a simple two-page ordering app. You will use
an LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini) to help you write the specification,
then give that spec to [Google Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com) and
iterate until Stitch produces a design that matches it.

**Make sure you create a WebApp, not a Mobile App.**

Your finished Stitch design must show that a customer:

- Can select the items on the menu, including more than one of each item
- Can see what they have selected and how many of each, on Page 1
- Can go to a Ready to Pay page that shows the totals and has a Submit Order button

You do not need to build a clickable prototype. You need two well-designed
pages and a consistent design system.

## The Menu

Use this menu exactly. Do not add, remove, or rename items, and do not
change prices.

**Pizzas**

- Pepperoni Pizza - Large \$12.95, Medium \$10.00, Small \$7.00
- Cheese Pizza - Large \$10.95, Medium \$9.25, Small \$6.50
- Eggplant Pizza - Large \$11.95, Medium \$9.75, Small \$6.75

**Sides**

- Fries - Large \$4.50, Small \$3.50
- Greek Salad - \$7.25

**Drinks**

- Coke - Large \$3.00, Medium \$2.00, Small \$1.00
- Sprite - Large \$3.00, Medium \$2.00, Small \$1.00
- Bottled Water - \$5.00

## Minimum Requirements

Your spec can add detail and design choices, but it must include everything
below.

### Page 1: Menu & Order

**Required Elements:**

- Restaurant name and logo/title area (invent a fictional restaurant)
- All menu items, grouped by category, with correct prices
- A way to choose a size for items that come in more than one size
- A quantity control for each item (add, increase, decrease)
- An order summary visible on Page 1 showing each selected item, its size, and its quantity
- A button to go to Page 2 (for example, "Ready to Pay" or "Review Order")

### Page 2: Ready to Pay

**Required Elements:**

- A list of every item in the order showing name, size, quantity, and line price (quantity × price)
- Subtotal and Order Total (tax is optional - if you include it, state the tax rate in your spec)
- A prominent Submit Order button
